name: eu-ioss-gb-sellers
description: Prepare the EU side of an IOSS sales workpaper for a Great Britain seller using an EU intermediary in 2026. Check imported consumer-sale eligibility, the inclusive consignment ceiling, marketplace responsibility and the actual registration start before applying destination VAT. Separate the temporary customs duty from the November Union handling fee and show how charges collected at checkout affect supply VAT. Reconcile monthly country and rate totals, corrections, payment references and retained records. Trigger on GB sales to EU consumers, IOSS intermediary, low-value imports, marketplace VAT, customs item charges and monthly IOSS reporting. Refer UK export, Northern Ireland, special customs, product-rate and unresolved national portal questions.
